axis_supply.supply_status: Strained for offensive operations during Gazala battle. Primary constraints: fuel deliveries from Tripoli (1,400km), British convoy interdiction, extended supply lines during Rommel's offensive. Water critical in desert advance. Motorized nature allowed better mobility than standard infantry divisions but fuel consumption high.

allied_supply.supply_status: Critically constrained during Bir Hakeim siege. Water rationed to 2 liters/man/day (June 8-10). Ammunition expenditure ~3,000 rounds/day during heavy combat. Final convoy breakthrough on June 8 delivered limited resupply. Evacuation necessary by June 10 due to depleted water and ammunition.
